comment: The declared socket surface of this box's commitwork-relevant processes. monitor/port-bind.mjs asserts the OBSERVED binds against these rows — declaration split from authority: this file states intent, it grants nothing and applies nothing. iface is a CLASS (loopback|any); auth is the expected unauthenticated answer at probePath (challenged = 401/403/redirect), null = no assertion, observed posture recorded only. required:false everywhere — a service that is down renders absent, its own state, never a finding and never clean.

binds.purpose: admin panel — published server (cloudflared origin for commitwork.portll.net)
admin panel — operator server (bootstrap + operator-only routes; CW_ADMIN_LOCAL_PORT, default published+1)
external overwatch SPINE (consumed by commitwork; not this repo's process)
LM Studio OpenAI-compatible endpoint (consumed: adjudication/reducer verdicts)
ollama endpoint (host listener only — REMOVED from fleet consumption 2026-08-27, see manifests/llm-hosts.json removed[]; still watched as a bind)
